themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: The AI selloff resumed on Oct 16: the Nasdaq fell 2.14% and 4.48% for the week, and the chip index fell about 2.5% for an eighth straight day. By dashboard closes CoreWeave fell 11.9% to 61.39 after its default swaps passed 1,000 basis points (record 1,194.5 intraday on Oct 15 per ICE) and its bonds yielded about 16%; Micron fell 5.6% to 878.84, Oracle 4.6% to 128.23 and Broadcom 4.5% to 328.75.
themes.for_you: No chip swings. Lenders, not customers, are setting prices now, so borrowers (CRWV, ORCL) stay off the put list. AVGO, NVDA and TSM are left out of both lists: their own business news has not changed, only their prices. Watch SK hynix on Oct 28.

themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: GE Vernova set its Q3 report for Oct 28 before the open, the same day as the Fed decision. Power names fell with tech on Oct 16: Bloom Energy fell 6.3% to 221.31 ahead of its Oct 22 report, Vertiv 3.9% to 206.42 and Eaton 2.8% to 391.25, while GEV slipped only 0.6% to 921.20 (dashboard).
themes.for_you: GEV is 'Buy zone now' but its Oct 28 report falls inside a November put expiry, so no GEV put idea. BE is 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' (up/down volume 0.85 and down 21% in a month); do not buy or sell puts before Oct 22. VRT and ETN are left out of both lists: they fell with the market, not on news.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: China's September rare earth exports rose 6.7% from a year ago to 4,269.8 tonnes, though January to September exports are still down 9.6% (SMM). On Oct 15 China's commerce ministry said it will keep easing rare earth export licenses for the EU and wants the same treatment on dual use cases. US producers fell: MP 3.5% to 40.17 and USAR 5.0% to 10.54 on Oct 16 (dashboard).
themes.for_you: No action. More Chinese supply flowing to the West weakens the scarcity case for US producers in the short run. MP is down 18.7% in a month and in a downtrend; no swing or put. The Jan 10, 2027 truce deadline is still the date that matters.

themes.name: Defense, drones and reshoring
themes.what: Defense stocks rose on a down day on Oct 16 as Gulf attacks spread toward Saudi Arabia's Yanbu bypass port: NOC rose 4.0% to 519.86, LMT 3.7% to 552.09 on 1.44x normal volume, RTX 3.7% to 193.92 on 1.87x and LHX 3.3% to 248.51 on 2.06x (dashboard). Coverage tied RTX to its recent awards, including Navy SM-6 work worth up to $24.4 billion.
themes.for_you: LMT and RTX moved to 'Buy zone, wait for the chart'. The failing check is up/down volume under 1.0 (0.93 and 0.74); a few more up days on volume would fix it. The stopgap budget through Dec 11 still blocks new programs.

themes.name: Healthcare and Medtech: Aging, Heart, Sugar, Hearing, Sight
themes.what: Viatris said the FDA approved Ryzumvi (phentolamine 0.75% eye drops) for presbyopia on Oct 16, a day before its Oct 17 goal date; Viatris sells it in the US under a license from Opus Genetics, based on the VEGA-2 and VEGA-3 trials. Health care went flat on Friday as energy led, which moved MDT (94.75), DXCM (86.04), PODD (141.10) and ZBH (94.98) to 'Buy zone now'.
themes.for_you: Long term: MDT, DXCM, PODD and ZBH are 'Buy zone now'; small tranches fit. Ryzumvi adds a near vision drop option; VTRS is left out because one eye drop is small for a company its size. Abbott reports Oct 21 before the open.

themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: Cybersecurity stocks broke on Oct 16: OKTA fell 10.2% to 187.26, S 7.7%, PANW 7.6% to 342.00, CRWD 7.0% to 227.39 and ZS 5.9% to 207.38 (dashboard). Bernstein cut Okta, Palo Alto and SentinelOne to Market Perform on valuation after a near 100% rally since early 2026, and reports of AI lab security products (Perplexity, and an OpenAI security acquisition reported Oct 14) added to the selling.
themes.for_you: No swings. Do not buy the drop in OKTA or PANW (both Wait). ZS is still above its zone (top 197.74); CHKP held up and stays 'Buy zone now'. ZS is left out of both lists because its own news has not changed.

innovations.name: Agriculture and Food
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Deere announced next generation perception autonomy kits in early October for tractors and tillage, orchard sprayers, and landscape and construction machines, and AGCO's Oct 6 Tech Day showed PTx retrofit autonomy for mixed fleets. Corteva set its first crop protection only report for Nov 11 after the close. Perfect Day now targets first commercial whey deliveries from India in Q1 2027. No stage moves: these are product launches, not new revenue.
innovations.for_you: No action. DE (641.86) is down 6.2% in a month and AGCO is in a downtrend, so neither is a swing; neither has a buy zone verdict to act on. Mark Nov 11 for Corteva's biologicals number. Retrofit kits sell even when new tractor sales are weak, which is the reason to keep watching DE.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.what: Pampa Energia director and 10% owner Marcos Mindlin bought about $35.1 million of PAM ADRs at $80.78 on Oct 15 (filed Oct 16), on top of buys by two vice presidents in late September; the insider cluster is about $42.7 million. PAM closed at 81.10 on Oct 16, up 0.8% (dashboard).
countries.for_you: Research only: PAM has no dashboard verdict. A controlling shareholder buying $35 million in the open market is the strongest kind of insider signal; if PAM gets a verdict, check whether the chart is ready before acting.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: A Futura/100% Cidades poll released Oct 16 has Flavio Bolsonaro at 50.8% of valid votes to Lula's 49.2%, a technical tie inside its 2.2 point margin. An average of eleven pollsters is 51.6% to 48.4%, with nine showing Bolsonaro ahead, while Polymarket (77%) and Kalshi (78%) gave Bolsonaro much higher odds as of Oct 16 (Rio Times). EWZ rose 0.6% to 41.83 on 1.58x volume and NU fell 1.2% to 14.56 (dashboard).
countries.for_you: No action until after Oct 25. Betting markets are far more confident than the polls, so a Lula win is the bigger surprise and would likely hit NU, ITUB and BBD hardest; a Bolsonaro win is mostly priced. All are left out of both lists because the result is still a coin flip in the polls. NU (14.56) is 'Buy zone now' but wait for the vote.

countries.name: China
countries.what: China releases Q3 GDP with September retail sales, factory output and investment at 02:00 GMT on Oct 19; a Reuters poll of 50 economists expects 4.4%, up from 4.3% in Q2 but below the 4.5% to 5% target. September rare earth exports rose 6.7% from a year ago to 4,269.8 tonnes (still down 9.6% for the year), and on Oct 15 the commerce ministry said it will keep easing rare earth licenses for the EU.
countries.for_you: No action this weekend. The GDP number lands Sunday evening Pacific time; a miss would weigh on China names and copper on Monday. More rare earths flowing to Europe trims the scarcity case for MP. BABA and PDD are left out until the number is out.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Brent settled at $109.86 on Oct 16, up 3.7% and its highest since May 19, and WTI at $101.41, up 10.4% on the week. At least ten ships have been attacked in or near Hormuz since Oct 11, a record pace, and Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a tanker caught fire after hitting a mine. On Oct 17 the Saudi led coalition intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at Yanbu, Saudi Arabia's Red Sea export port that bypasses Hormuz, and missiles hit Aden's airport on Oct 16. Iran denied a role in Houthi attacks and offered to mediate.
countries.for_you: Oil names stay helped and the energy swings on the scorecard are all in profit; keep the dashboard stops (XOM 162.99, CVX 210.45, COP 135.75) over the weekend because a ceasefire headline from Iran's mediation offer could gap oil down. OXY stays mixed: its Gulf assets sit in the war zone.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: The KOSPI closed Oct 16 up 2.05% at 5,668.06 but lost 14.46% for the week, its biggest weekly drop since October 2008 (TradingKey). Samsung closed at 215,500 won (up 2.62%) and SK hynix at 1,272,000 won (up 0.79%). In New York EWY fell 3.7% to 150.44 the same day as US chip stocks sold off again (dashboard).
countries.for_you: No action. A 14% week is forced selling; wait for SK hynix on Oct 28 before any Korea or memory trade. Korean bank ADRs stay hurt into the Oct 22 Bank of Korea decision. CPNG is left out: its business is retail, not chips.
